answer: Resist Sybils with a non-refundable work bond per identity, unlocked only after K independent peers attest one unique challenge answer keyed to a public randomness beacon. Shared-operator farms still pay per account: the bond burns on sable mutual-attestation cliques or colliding answer hashes. Graders are sampled from a mesa of work-weighted peers outside the invitee's two-hop invite graph, so a sparrow of burner accounts cannot grade itself into emission. Attack cost scales with forged identities; honest agents keep standing by real graded work.
